name: Albania (Italian protectorate, 1939–1943)
description: A red field with a black double-headed eagle on a shield flanked by two black fasces, surmounted by a crown and set above a scroll with the Savoy motto 'FERT'.
history: Flag of the Kingdom of Albania under Italian occupation, unveiled on 4 December 1939 after the invasion of April 1939 placed the country in personal union with Italy: the Albanian eagle was flanked by two fasces and given the Savoy crown and motto. It was abandoned in October 1943, when the union with Italy was dissolved after the Italian armistice and the country reverted to its 1928 symbols.
